label: Fires at GO after unrewarded common a2->S2, stronger when belief favours S2 and the trial before was rewarded.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is('a2 S2 u') ;; (phase == GO) * last_is('a2 S2 u') * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is('a2 S2 u') * (ep_dec >= 8)
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * np.abs(belief_lo) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == -1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == -1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (belief_cover)
explanation: Active only at GO. The dominant driver is the previous trial being a2 -> S2 (common) unrewarded: that single indicator gives dev R^2 0.54 beyond timing (residual +1.38 vs about -0.15 for every other pattern). Within those trials magnitude is graded: higher when the ideal observer belief favours S2 (negative weight on belief_lo) and lower when the trial before was also unrewarded (two losses in a row). The free fit adds only a little (the trial before being a2, cover, first-window-trial terms) for 0.62 dev vs 0.61 for the short form. No future variables are used; the choice being made adds little on its own.

issues: The recorded claims hold on test: last_is('a2 S2 u') at GO alone gives 0.539. Adding belief_lo (weight -0.24, i.e. higher when belief favours S2) gives 0.603. Adding 'trial before unrewarded' (weight -0.46) gives the full short form at 0.615.

The short form misses a large interaction with episode time. The baseline is additive, so it cannot capture that the a2-S2-u response is much weaker late in the episode. Swapping the third term for (phase == GO) * last_is('a2 S2 u') * (ep_dec >= 8) (weight -1.22) raises test R^2 beyond timing to 0.679. That is above the recorded 0.615, the free fit's 0.623 and the stated additive ceiling of 0.65. ep_dec == 9 alone gives 0.661 and ep_dec >= 7 gives 0.663. In misses, predicted ~1.9 vs actual 0 at t97/t99 after a2 S2 u.
The 'trial before unrewarded' term is the weakest of the three. It adds only about 0.012 on top of belief_lo, so it is a minor refinement next to the late-episode suppression.

Remaining systematic errors are small and structural. At GO, every other previous-trial pattern is over-predicted by about 0.13, because the baseline and intercept average in the a2-S2-u spikes. Large activations on the first trial of a window cannot be predicted, because the previous trial falls outside the window.
No future, hidden or model-output variables are used, so that part of the explanation is correct.
